# Index benchmark results (measured)

*Generated by `scripts/benchmark_indexes.py` on 2026-09-29 22:04. PostgreSQL 16.14 (Debian 16.14-1.pgdg13+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu. Each time is the **median of 11 runs** of `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` after one warm-up run; data is cached in memory, so these are warm-cache timings on a laptop running PostgreSQL in Docker. Use the ratios and the plan types, not the absolute milliseconds.*

| Query | Scenario | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Change | Plan before | Plan after |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Q501 | One customer's order history | 4.12 | 0.13 | 31.0x faster | Seq Scan | Bitmap Index Scan (idx_orders_customer) |
| Q502 | Revenue in one month (date range) | 5.50 | 0.96 | 5.7x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_orders_date) |
| Q503 | All sales lines of one product | 1.48 | 0.11 | 13.0x faster | Index Scan (sales_order_items_order_id_product_id_key) | Bitmap Index Scan (idx_items_product) |
| Q504 | Correlated subquery per row (from Q108) | 321.81 | 148.85 | 2.2x faster | Seq Scan | Seq Scan, Bitmap Index Scan (idx_orders_customer) |
| Q505 | Returned quantity per product (join on return_items.order_item_id) | 1.81 | 0.72 | 2.5x faster | Seq Scan, Index Scan (sales_order_items_order_id_product_id_key) | Seq Scan, Bitmap Index Scan (idx_items_product) |
| Q506 | Ledger for one store + product in date order | 29.81 | 0.03 | 1104.2x faster | Seq Scan | Bitmap Index Scan (idx_invtxn_store_product_date) |
| Q507 | Completed orders with no payment (anti-join, from DQ21) | 41.94 | 31.73 | same plan (timing gap is noise) | Seq Scan | Seq Scan |
| Q508 | Open purchase orders ordered by due date | 1.85 | 0.14 | 13.2x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_purchases_open_expected) |
| Q509 | Case-insensitive e-mail lookup | 4.23 | 0.04 | 120.9x faster | Seq Scan | Bitmap Index Scan (idx_customers_email_lower) |
| Q510 | One store, one quarter | 3.71 | 0.73 | 5.1x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_orders_date) |
| Q511 | Full-table aggregation (monthly revenue) - an index should NOT help | 32.15 | 35.82 | same plan (timing gap is noise) | Seq Scan | Seq Scan |
| Q512 | Stock of one product across stores | 0.26 | 0.04 | 6.0x faster | Seq Scan | Bitmap Index Scan (idx_inventory_product) |
| Q513 | Products of one category | 0.08 | 0.08 | same plan (timing gap is noise) | Seq Scan | Seq Scan |
| Q514 | Returns of one specific order | 0.16 | 0.02 | 8.1x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_returns_order) |
| Q515 | Payments of one specific order | 3.62 | 0.02 | 213.2x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_payments_order) |
| Q516 | Return lines of one specific sold line | 0.26 | 0.05 | 5.3x faster | Seq Scan | Index Scan (idx_return_items_order_item) |
| Q517 | Same question as Q504, rewritten (pre-aggregated join instead of a correlated subquery) | 32.19 | 35.88 | same plan (timing gap is noise) | Seq Scan | Seq Scan |
